note: Verifies that Playwright 1.61's context.credentials virtual authenticator drives the passkey (WebAuthn) ceremony across three engines, and documents how the ceremony fails when install() is omitted. No statistical distribution applies: each row is a pass/fail behavior observation, not a timing sample.
subject: @playwright/test 1.61.1 — context.credentials

api_ground_truth.create(rpId, options?): options {id?, privateKey?, publicKey?, userHandle?} → {id, rpId, userHandle, privateKey, publicKey}. rpId-only auto-generates an ECDSA P-256 keypair; credentials are always discoverable (resident).
api_ground_truth.get(options?): {id?, rpId?} → Array<{id, rpId, userHandle, privateKey, publicKey}>. Exports keys, for storing / re-seeding.
api_ground_truth.install(): overrides navigator.credentials.create/get. MUST be called before the page touches navigator.credentials; seeding without install() leaves the credential invisible to the page.
api_ground_truth.intentional_limits: No UV toggle, transport choice, attestation format, signCount, or non-discoverable option. P-256 fixed.

behaviors_verified.claim: A seeded discoverable credential resolves a usernameless navigator.credentials.get() on the page — rawId and userHandle match the seed and a signature is produced.

The page registers via create(), the test exports the keys via context.credentials.get(), re-seeds them into a fresh context via create(rpId, {id, privateKey, publicKey, userHandle}), and logs in there.
With install() active but nothing seeded, the page get() rejects with NotAllowedError.
Omitting install() does not fail cleanly — the ceremony falls through to each engine's native behavior, which differs per engine. The test asserts the ceremony never silently succeeds.
behaviors_verified.firefox: pass (native hangs indefinitely; test resolves via a race timeout)

install_omitted_native_behavior.note: The portability trap: skipping install() is not a clean no-op. Observed native behavior per engine on 2026-06-24.

totals.note: 12 = 4 scenarios x 3 engines. Wall time is machine-dependent context, not an evidence claim.

cited_not_measured.claim: Platform-authenticator UX (Windows Hello / iCloud Keychain) — UV gesture, attestation, transport — is NOT modeled by the virtual authenticator.
cited_not_measured.source: Playwright docs + the API's intentional-minimalism note; stated as a limit in the post, not measured here.
